findings.evidence: Valve Corporation and Valve S.A.R.L (collectively, Valve) respect the privacy of its online visitors and users of its products and services. Valve recognizes the importance of protecting information collected from users and has adopted this privacy policy to inform users about how Valve gathers, stores, and uses information derived from their use of Valve products, services and online sites.
findings.rationale: The policy mentions collecting and storing information, which includes IP addresses and device IDs.
findings.verifier_reason: The policy evidence does not explicitly disclose the collection of IP addresses and device IDs.
